title: Natural Ways to Improve Microvascular Coronary Reactivity Without Nitroglycerin—Backed by 5 RCTs in Women 52–68 With INOCA (Ischemia With No Obstructive CAD)
description: Details evidence-based nonpharmacologic strategies—including timed L-arginine + vitamin C dosing, cold-water facial immersion protocols, and paced breathing frequency optimization—to enhance coronary flow reserve.
